Summary: John's testing command: believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God, because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
Commandment: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
Application: The test is confessional: every spirit that confesses Jesus Christ come in the flesh is of God. Openness to spiritual claims without testing is credulity, not faith.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: 'many false prophets are gone out into the world' (1 John 4:1).
